data.one_liner: UI wrapper around permission_handler that simplifies permission state handling.
data.what_it_does: Provides a PermissionGuard widget and requestGuarded method to display appropriate UI for permission statuses. Allows extensive customization of dialogs, loaders, and texts.
use_when: You need a ready‑made UI for permission requests
You want consistent permission handling across Android, iOS, web and desktop
You prefer declarative widget integration with optional imperative calls
avoid_when: You already have custom permission UI
You only need raw permission checks without extra UI overhead
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Works on all major platforms supported by permission_handler
weaknesses: Adds another layer on top of permission_handler
May not cover very specific permission flows
data.setup_notes: Follow permission_handler's platform‑specific setup (Android manifest, iOS Info.plist, web config, etc.) before using permission_guard

alternatives.name: permission_handler
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core package without extra UI, lower overhead if you only need permission checks
